input.idea: I Built a Self-Sustaining Shelter in an Inverted Gravity World, But I Couldn't Use Any Tools or Redstone

reasoning: The idea introduces a unique physics-based constraint (inverted gravity) combined with a tool restriction, creating a clear challenge. It offers visual potential through creative building solutions and maintains curiosity about how the shelter will function. It avoids repeating existing 'survival' or 'city survival' concepts by focusing on a novel mechanic.
improved_version: I Built a Self-Sustaining Shelter in an Inverted Gravity World, But I Couldn't Use Any Tools or Redstone – Can I Survive a Night Cycle?
improvement_reasoning: Adding the night cycle constraint creates a time-based urgency and escalation. It introduces a new layer of challenge (managing resources during darkness) while maintaining the core inverted gravity premise, enhancing story potential and retention through escalating stakes.
